text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...That underclassman must've been hurt. 
Even if I was focused on training, giving 
such a cold, dismissive reply..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Besides... today's time. I didn't push 
myself hard enough. Tomorrow, I'll... 
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Right, I need to get to sleep. For 
tomorrow's sake, quickly... quickly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to stop her pre-bedtime 
self-reflection session, Verxina ended up 
staying up late...
